description: This file defines structures, enums, and function prototypes related to Git objects, including object parsing, lookup, and management within a repository.

methods.name: parsed_object_pool_new
methods.description: Creates a new parsed_object_pool associated with a repository.

methods.name: parsed_object_pool_clear
methods.description: Clears the parsed_object_pool, freeing resources.

methods.name: parsed_object_pool_reset_commit_grafts
methods.description: Resets commit grafts in the parsed_object_pool.

methods.name: object_array_init
methods.description: Initializes an object_array.

methods.name: object_type
methods.description: Returns the object type based on mode.

methods.name: create_ce_mode
methods.description: Creates a mode value for a directory entry.

methods.name: canon_mode
methods.description: Canonicalizes a mode value.

methods.name: parse_mode
methods.description: Parses a mode string into a mode value.

methods.name: parse_object
methods.description: Parses an object from the repository by its ID.

methods.name: parse_object_with_flags
methods.description: Parses an object with specific flags.

methods.name: parse_object_or_die
methods.description: Parses an object or terminates on error.

methods.name: parse_object_buffer
methods.description: Parses an object from a buffer.

methods.name: lookup_unknown_object
methods.description: Looks up an object without knowing its type.

methods.name: lookup_object_by_type
methods.description: Looks up an object by type.

methods.name: peel_object
methods.description: Peels a tag object to its underlying object.

methods.name: object_list_insert
methods.description: Inserts an object into an object list.

methods.name: object_list_contains
methods.description: Checks if an object is in a list.

methods.name: object_list_free
methods.description: Frees an object list.

methods.name: add_object_array
methods.description: Adds an object to an object array.

methods.name: add_object_array_with_path
methods.description: Adds an object with a path to an object array.

methods.name: object_array_pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the last object from an array.

methods.name: object_array_filter
methods.description: Filters objects in an array based on a predicate.

methods.name: object_array_clear
methods.description: Clears an object array.

methods.name: clear_object_flags
methods.description: Clears specific flags from objects in a repository.

methods.name: repo_clear_commit_marks
methods.description: Clears commit flags in a repository.
